description: Training pipeline micronaut — operates under Mx2LM. Owns the full corpus→.kblm lifecycle: corpus extraction (extract_corpus.py), n-gram counting, ARPA model build, and KBLM pack (pack_srilm.py). Dispatched when a user asks to retrain, rebuild the language model, add corpus files, or when Mx2LM detects its .kblm is stale. AIML patterns in data/alice/train-u.aiml. Produces bin/mx2lm.kblm which Mx2LM consumes for candidate scoring.

pop.description: Ingest the corpus source list from srilm.sources in the track file. Detect which files are new or modified since the last training run (stored in gram key train:last_run). Emit a change manifest.

wo.description: Build ordered file manifest across all source types: directory (*.jsonl scan), parquet (.parquet), flat JSONL. Annotate each entry with schema type so extract_corpus.py can route correctly.

yax.description: Admission gate: accept only sources that exist on disk and have content. Skip sources that are unchanged since train:last_run (mtime-based). Load semantic bias evidence from bias_log_reference (field/distilled/compare.bias.jsonl) and store in train:bias_evidence for use at Sek. Emit the admitted file list.

sek.description: Execute the 3-step pipeline: (1) py -3 tools\extract_corpus.py <admitted_files> --append -o tools\corpus.txt, (2) ngram-count.exe -text corpus.txt -order 3 -write srilm.counts, (3) ngram-count.exe -read srilm.counts -lm mx2lm.arpa -unk -cdiscount 0.5. Streams stdout to gram key train:pipeline_log.

chen.description: Run pack_srilm.py --verify on the output ARPA, then verify the produced .kblm CRC32. Read bin/mx2lm.kblm header: check magic=='KBLM', vocab_size > 0, total_ngrams > 0. If verification fails, status = CONTRADICTED and pipeline is blocked at Ch'en.

xul.description: Commit the new .kblm: write train:last_run timestamp to gram store, update train:model_path, notify Mx2LM via gram key mx2lm:kblm_ready = true. Xul is the only phase that writes the training outcome to persistent state.

corpus_sources.note: chunk_1.jsonl .. chunk_35.jsonl, UTF-8 BOM, messages format
AST/math semantic gold mine; coarse_gram dot-paths, id labels, NL strings
messages array + input/output/question at top level
original SRILM runtime corpora: wikitext2, squad, ag_news, english-triples

trigger_conditions: user explicitly asks to train, retrain, or rebuild the language model
user adds new corpus files and asks to update the model
mx2lm:kblm_ready is false and Mx2LM is dispatched
train:last_run is older than 7 days (advisory, not enforced — Ch'en verifies)

epistemic_states.MISS: one or more corpus sources not found on disk
epistemic_states.UNKNOWN: pipeline ran but kblm verification not yet performed
epistemic_states.CONTRADICTED: kblm CRC mismatch or ngram-count.exe failed

relations.note: TRAIN-µ builds the .kblm that Mx2LM consumes for candidate scoring
Mx2LM is the parent; TRAIN-µ operates in its authority domain
shell execution (ngram-count.exe, py -3) routed through TOOL-µ
